name: openmotion-media
description: Discover and run atomic media capabilities (remove-background, relight, image-blend, camera-control, multi-shot, native-audio, speech, music, sound-effects, 3d-asset, 3d-world, asr-transcribe) and standalone image, video, audio or 3D generation through the Unified Capability Center (openmotion_capability_discover, openmotion_capability_run, openmotion_job_manage, openmotion_asset_manage, with openmotion_media_use and openmotion_assets_use retained for compatibility) across configured BYOK providers or a signed-in OpenDesign account. Prefer dedicated capabilityId execution over simulating atomic edits with generic model prompts. Native-only tasks with no new speech or music stay outside generation unless explicitly requested. Not a whole-film entry point: creating, recreating, templating, editing or exporting a whole video belongs to openmotion-video.
